offering_description.value: Trinity leases and sells railcars to North American rail shippers. It operates a lease fleet, manufactures railcars, and provides logistics, maintenance and repair services.

quotes.quote: TrinityRail is an industry-leading railcar leasing company, enhanced by our manufacturing and service capabilities. We are a leader in providing leasing and logistics services, and act as an integrated and strategic partner to stakeholders across the industry. We are on a mission to increase rail’s modal share and convenience by delivering more sustainable, end-to-end solutions that bridge the first and last miles for our customers.

Trinity began providing industrial products and services to customers more than 85 years ago. We started as a small butane-tank manufacturer and evolved over time into a premier provider of railcar products and services in North America with a leading railcar lease fleet and manufacturing, maintenance and repair operations.

quotes.quote: The TrinityRail platform plays an important role in the North American supply chain by facilitating the transportation of bulk commodities and goods by rail. Railcar transportation is sustainable and is the most economical land-based mode of transportation. At Trinity, we strive to employ company resources in ways that make positive contributions to our stakeholders for the benefit of current and future generations.

At Trinity, we are committed to Delivering Goods for the Good of All. Look around and you’ll see us. Our railcars have likely carried the materials that built them. We may have delivered it from the farm to grocer. We likely transported and fueled it. That’s us too.
